item.title: Dawson's Creek Star James Van Der Beek Dies at 48
item.description: LOS ANGELES, CA — James Van Der Beek, who rose to fame as the aspiring filmmaker Dawson Leery on the WB teen drama Dawson’s Creek, has died. He was 48.His wife, Kimberly Van Der Beek, confirmed his death on Wednesday in a statement posted to Instagram.“He met his final days with courage, faith, and grace,” she wrote. “For now, we ask for peaceful privacy as we grieve our loving husband, father, son, brother, and friend.” Learn More Here.

item.title: Man Faces Federal Human Smuggling Charges in 2023 Ozona Crash That Killed 4
item.description: OZONA, TX — A federal grand jury has indicted a Bossier City, Louisiana, man on 13 counts related to human smuggling in connection with a March 2023 crash in Crockett County that killed a 7-year-old girl, her 71-year-old grandmother, and two others. Learn More Here.
